senses.gloss:
नड् नड् (connected with rt. नट् = नृत्),
cl. 10. P. नाडयति, &c., to fall.

नड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (the n. does not seem to
occur), a species of reed, Arundo Tibialis or Karka;
(Ved. written नऌअ; cf. नल); (अस्), m. a particular
tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass
bracelets; N. of a prince with the patronymic
Naiṣidha; (according to the commentator) = Nala
Naiṣadha; N. of a Nāga; [cf. Lith. néndre†, ‘a
reed.’]
—नड-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in
reeds.
—नड-भक्त, अम्, n. a place abounding in
reeds.
—नड-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of reeds,
made of reeds.
—नड-मीन, अस्, m. a small fish, a
species of sprat frequenting reedy places (= नल-
मीन).
—नड-वन, अम्, n. a thicket of reeds; N.
of a place.
—नड-संहति, इस्, f. a collection or
quantity of reeds.
—नडागार (˚ड-आग्˚), अम्, n.
a hut of reeds.
—नडा-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of an
elephant.
नाड नाड, अम्, n. = नाल.
नडक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), the hollow of a bone.

नडकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in reeds (as a
field &c.).
नडस, अस्, ई, अम्, covered with reeds.
नडिनी, f. a quantity of reeds, a reed bed.
नडिल, अस्, आ, अम्, reedy, covered with reeds.
नड्या, f. a quantity of reeds, a bed of reeds.

नड्वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (नड् for नड), covered
with reeds, abounding in reeds.

नड्वल, अस्, आ, अम् (नड् for नड), abounding
in reeds, reedy; (अम्), n. a quantity of reeds, a
reed bed; (आ), f. a quantity of reeds; N. of the wife
of Manu Cākṣuṣa; (also written नवला; cf. नाड्-
वलेय.)
नड्वा-भू, ऊस्, f. a house or hut of reeds (?).

नडह नडह, अस्, आ, अम्, lovely, beautiful,
desirable.
नाडपित् नाडपित्, Ved., N. of a place.

नाडायन नाडायन, अस्, m. (fr. नड), a
patronymic from Naḍa.
नाडायनक, relating to Nāḍāyana.

नाडि नाडि, इस्, or नाडी, f. (fr. नड, q. v.),
the tubular stalk or culm of any plant; the hollow
stalk of a lotus, &c.; any tubular organ of the body
(as an artery, vein, intestine, &c.); any pipe or tube,
a flute; a fistulous sore, fistula, sinus [cf. नाडी-
व्रण]; the pulse either at the hand or feet, &c.;
a measure of time = (1/60) of a sidereal day or (1/2) Mu-
hūrta; a period or hour of twenty-four minutes; the
box of a wheel (Ved.); a sort of bent grass; a juggling
trick, deception.
—नाडि-चीर, अम्, n. a small reed
or tube round which the woof is wound, (it is then
used as a shuttle.)
—नाडिन्-धम, अस्, आ, अम्,
causing movement of the intestines (as fright), terri-
fying; (अस्), m. a goldsmith; (also read नाडीन्-
धम.)
—नाडिन्-धय, अस्, ई, अम्, drinking or
sucking through a tube.
—नाडि-पत्त्र, अम्, n. an
esculent root, Arum Colocasia.
—नाडि-मण्डल,
अम्, n. the celestial equator.
—नाडी-कलापक, अस्,
m. a species of plant (= गण्डिनी in Hindī).
—नाडी-
चरण, अस्, m. ‘whose feet or legs are like stalks,’
a bird.
—नाडी-जङ्घ, अस्, m. ‘having stalk-like
legs,’ a crow; N. of a fabulous crane; N. of a holy
teacher or saint; [cf. नालि-जङ्घ.]
—नाडी-त-
रङ्ग, अस्, m. = काकोल; a sort of poison; an astro-
loger; a ravisher, debaucher (= रत-हिण्डक; cf.
नारी-तरङ्गक).
—नाडी-तिक्त, अस्, m. a species
of Nimba growing in Nepal (= नेपाल-निम्ब).
—नाडी-दत्त, अस्, m. = नाडिका-दत्त, q. v.
—ना-
डी-देह, अस्, m. ‘thin-bodied like a tube or stalk,’
N. of one of the attendants of Śiva (= भृङ्गिन्;
cf. नाडी-विग्रह).
—नाडी-नक्षत्र, अम्, n. the
planet of a person's nativity (= जन्म-नक्षत्र).
—नाडीन्-धम = नाडिन्-धम, q. v.
—नाडी-
परीक्षा, f. feeling the pulse; N. of a medical work.
—नाडी-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a pharmaceutical
work commented on by Śaṅkara-sena.
—नाडी-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, abounding with blood-vessels.
—नाडी-
यन्त्र, अम्, n. any tubular instrument.
—नाडी-
विग्रह, अस्, m., N. of Bhṛṅgin, one of Śiva's chief
attendants; [cf. नाडी-देह.]
—नाडी-व्रण, अस्,
m. an ulcer, a fistula, fistulous sore, sinus.
—नाडी-
शाक, अस्, m. a species of vegetable (= नाडीक).
—नाडी-शुद्धि, इस्, f., N. of a Yoga work.
—नाडी-
सङ्ख्या, f., N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—नाडी-सञ्चार, अस्, m., N. of the forty-second
chapter of the Jñāna-khaṇḍa of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—नाडी-स्नेह, अस्, m. a N. of Bhṛṅgin; see नाडी-
विग्रह.
—नाडी-हिङ्गु, उ, n. = हिङ्गु-नाडिका, the
resin of the plant Gardenia Gummifera?; (उस्), m.
a plant (= वंश-पत्त्री).

नाडिक, अम्, n. the plant Ocimum Sanctum (=
काल-शाक); (आ), f. a hollow stalk or stalk in
general; any tubular organ of the body (as an artery,
vein, intestine, &c.); a fistulous sore; a ray of the
sun (supposed to be hollow); an Indian hour or twenty-
four minutes = (1/60) of a sidereal day = (1/2) Muhūrta; a
measure of length = (1/2) Daṇḍa, (also read नारिका);
a piece of metal on which the hours are struck, an
Indian clock, a gong.
—नाडिका-दत्त, अस्, m., N.
of an author mentioned in the Saṃskāra-tattva by
Raghu-nandana; [cf. नाडी-दत्त.]

नाडीक, अस्, m. a species of pot-herb (= com-
monly पाट्शाक्); Corchorus Olitorius; (आ), f. the
wind-pipe or throat.

नाडिकेल नाडिकेल or नाडीकेल, अस्, m. =
नारिकेल, the cocoa-nut palm.

नाडीच नाडीच, अस्, m. an esculent root,
Colocasia Antiquorum.

नाड्वलेय नाड्वलेय, अस्, m. a metronymic
from Naḍvalā.
